sections.label: Early game
sections.desc: Souls 0-9,600 (levels 1-16). Abilities gained (both point models agree): Crimson Slash T3. 4.8k spikes: weapon 4.8k at Recharging Rush, vitality 4.8k at Extra Regen. Ultimate (Shadow Transformation) is available from Grit.

sections.label: Situational counters
sections.legacy_desc: Dying after Lifestrike? Buy what is killing you, cheapest first. Not dying? Skip. Sell Berserker.
sections.desc: Dying after Lifestrike? Buy what is killing you, cheapest first. Not dying? Skip. Sell Berserker.

items.name: Counterspell
items.caption: Your next parry blocks an enemy ability's damage and effects (0.8s window, 23s cooldown), so it only answers an ability you can see coming.
items.legacy_note: A big ult you can see coming, like Lash's or Infernus's.

items.name: Dispel Magic
items.caption: Purges non-ultimate debuffs (silence, slow, disarm) and heals 250, but cannot be used while stunned or asleep, so it answers a hex or silence and not a stun already on you.
items.legacy_note: Hexes and slows stop you getting in.

items.name: Unstoppable
items.caption: A stun cancels your Flying Slash (movement). Activate this before the stun lands (it cannot be used while stunned): 5.5s immune to stun, silence, sleep, root and disarm, 60s cooldown.
items.legacy_note: Stuns keep catching you on the way in.

items.name: Metal Skin
items.caption: Immune to bullets only, for 5s on a 24s cooldown, at 1.5m/s slower: buy it against one gun carry, not against ability damage.
items.legacy_note: Their gun carry is out-shooting you.

items.name: Spirit Resilience
items.caption: Spirit resist 30, plus 15 more below 50% health: buy it when enemy spirit damage is what kills you.
items.legacy_note: Most of their damage is spirit.

items.name: Healbane
items.why: no hero-, build- or timing-specific reason established from the data layers implemented
items.legacy_note: They heal a lot: Rem, Dynamo, Kelvin, a Healing Rite or Rescue Beam user.

items.name: Indomitable
items.caption: Same-slot upgrade of Reactive Barrier for 4,800 more souls: cooldown reduction on proc 0 to 20; bullet resist 0 to 10..

items.name: Witchmail
items.why: only generic accurate reasons: Takes vitality from 12,800 to 19,200 invested: bonus 50 to 54 vitality bonus.

items.name: Leech
items.why: only generic accurate reasons: Takes vitality from 12,800 to 19,200 invested: bonus 50 to 54 vitality bonus.

items.name: Refresher
items.caption: Resets every ability and charge: up to 182s of base cooldown across your kit, 150s of it the ultimate; the item has its own cooldown of 300s. Takes spirit from 4,800 to 11,200 invested, crossing the 6.4k, 8k, 11.2k tiers: bonus 38 to 59 spirit power.

items.name: Cheat Death
items.why: only generic accurate reasons: Takes vitality from 12,800 to 19,200 invested: bonus 50 to 54 vitality bonus.

items.name: Divine Barrier
items.caption: Cast on yourself or an ally: removes non-stun debuffs and gives a 600 barrier for 6s, 45s cooldown (halved when cast on an ally), so it covers debuffs and burst damage but not a stun.
items.legacy_note: If you bought Dispel Magic, sell it for this.

items.name: Healing Tempo
items.caption: Same-slot upgrade of Healing Booster for 4,800 more souls: bonus fire rate 0 to 35; tech resist 0 to 10..
